Hoover self-published Slammed in January 2012.
Hoover's novel It Ends with Us was published in 2016.
A sequel to It Ends with Us, It Starts with Us, was published on October 18, 2022, by Atria Books.
As of October 2022, Hoover has sold more than 20 million books.
